citations.assessment: Pesahim attributes the support to Todos. Rashi explicitly explains the idiom as giving goods to scholars to trade.
The checked baraita names both Todos and the sender Shimon ben Shetah.
The Tosdos narrative and threat are on the same folio. Preserve each source’s sender formulation.
A substantially matching warning is directly present in Beitzah 23a.
The text has the custom and addresses Tevdas, and separately says he supported scholars.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015

notes.text: Rashi explicitly explains the idiom as giving scholars merchandise so they can earn from trading it. The correction renders the financial support as an action rather than a literal placement in a purse.
